description: MUST-FAIL: non-conforming profile. A non-conforming Profile-A verifier reaches inside Profile-B internal fields to evaluate the binding — violating profile independence. This breaks decomposable verification.
spec_ref: draft-mih-sokolov-scitt-payload-binding-00 §8 ('A payload profile MUST NOT impose requirements on the internal structure or field values of another payload profile.')

non_conforming_verifier_behavior.violation: Profile-A verifier requires that the authorization-doc has scope='temperature-write' and subject='WS-42' as a condition of verifying the decision-record binding.
non_conforming_verifier_behavior.why_wrong: Profile-A MUST NOT impose requirements on the internal structure or field values of Profile-B (authorization-doc). Profile-A may only use the typed reference to establish content binding. Whether the authorization-doc's scope and subject satisfy any access-control policy belongs to the authorization-doc profile semantics or the consuming application — not to decision-record binding verification.
non_conforming_verifier_behavior.consequence: A new authorization-doc profile version that renames 'scope' to 'permission_scope' would silently break all non-conforming Profile-A verifiers, defeating the independence guarantee. Conforming verifiers remain unaffected because they do not read inside Profile-B fields.

conforming_alternative.action: Profile-A verifier verifies only that authorization.digest matches the recomputed derived identifier of the authorization-doc bytes. Scope/subject evaluation is delegated to the authorization-doc profile verifier or the consuming application, separately.
conforming_alternative.result: PASS for the CPB binding layer
